Each Helium-3 Extractor produces 240 items/min. Give each extractor its own currently available Rail v.2: 240 ÷ 240 = 100% utilization per rail. Together they produce 2 × 240 = 480 items/min, so they could instead merge into one Rail v.3 at 480 ÷ 480 = 100%, but the dedicated v.2 lines avoid depending on unverified merge queuing behavior.

Extractor heat is 18 for the Ore Excavator v.2 plus 2 × 60 for the Helium-3 Extractors, totaling 138. The Constructorizer consumes 500 heat and the Facturer 650, totaling 1,150. Safe proposal: use a distributed extraction outpost with one Rail v.3 ore trunk and two Rail v.2 helium spurs; rails also conduct electricity. Reserve buffers and junction space, and do not make safety depend on unverified Rail Modulator merge behavior. Keep the Constructorizer and Facturer off the level-0 Core; colocate them only after upgrading to at least Base Core level 1 (2,500 capacity), while still budgeting every other building and generator. This preserves Fire Wave protection and leaves room for expansion.

answer.answer: Straylight’s corrected boundary is a user-owned, portable agent context and durable-work layer. Its product gate is no longer retrieval recall alone: it must prove that a fresh agent can resume, advance, verify, and correctly preserve real work across sessions.

claims.value: Straylight is an agent-first, user-owned, portable context and durable-work layer: a product and protocol for durable machine continuity across agent runtimes. It is not primarily a notes app, wiki, transcript archive, synchronized folder, retrieval product, or memory database.

Beyond learned knowledge, Straylight must preserve the live state needed to resume and advance work: goals, evidence, decisions, hypotheses, plans, artifacts, computations, unresolved questions, rejected paths, checkpoints, and next actions. A later agent must be able to inspect how that state was reached, revise it as evidence changes, and leave a better durable state behind.

Obsidian and Markdown are useful prototype corpora, human-readable projections, and export formats, but they are not Straylight’s canonical product boundary or interaction model. Metis organizes the human knowledge base and supplies a representative corpus; Straylight is the portable agent context and durable-work product designed over corpora of that kind, whose canonical representation need not be raw Markdown.

The first benchmark was too narrow because it was a retrieval-readiness test over 44 non-private project notes, 20 questions, and 53 gold evidence items, exercising memory.open, memory.query, and memory.read while leaving model-directed memory.compute and memory.verify untested. Retrieval-only scoring is now a regression lane, not the product gate. The expanded evaluation must compare direct filesystem access, a model-directed agent workspace using open, query, read, compute, verify, checkpoint, and revision behavior, and fixed handoff/context packs. On Warmind/Charlemagne performance and incident work, StarRupture factory planning, Switzerland trip planning under changing constraints, and Straylight’s own evolution, it must prove that a fresh agent can correctly and completely resume and advance real work, iterate after changes, inspect full sources, handle temporal supersession and contradictions, perform quantitative artifact work, verify before acting, preserve source fidelity, and leave correct durable next-state and handoff artifacts.
